name: Artifactor: Visual HTML Editor
description: Visual editor for AI-generated HTML artifacts. Edit text and styling, add or remove elements, present fullscreen and print to PDF.

content_security_policy.sandbox: sandbox allow-scripts allow-forms allow-modals allow-popups; default-src 'self' data: blob: https:; script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' 'unsafe-eval' data: blob:; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' data: https:; img-src * data: blob:; font-src https: data: blob:; connect-src data: blob:; form-action 'none'
